newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 22.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Nov. 22:
WASHINGTON - CompuServe Inc. said competition has become so intense that it is abandoning efforts to chase a consumer mass market.
NEW YORK - Stocks have been chugging higher all year, but since the election they have hit overdrive with only brief pauses, and the Dow is up nearly 24 percent for the year.

WASHINGTON - General Motors Corp. and four big Japanese auto companies have agreed to stop advertising "no money down" and "low monthly payments" on car deals that in fact carry substantial upfront or hidden charges.
NEW YORK - General Motors Corp. plans to reduce airbag inflation speeds next year to make them safer, and to install airbag cutoff switches in some pickups.
